zh: a novel (1726) by Jonathan Swift in which he attacked the British attitudes of his time towards religion, science, the law, etc., using satire. Lemuel Gulliver, an English traveller, visits strange lands, including Lilliput, where the people are all tiny, Brobdingnag, where the people are all giants (= very large people), and the country of the Houyhnhnms and the Yahoos, where the horses are wise and the humans are stupid and cruel. The story has always been very popular with both adults and children.

en: to swallow large amounts of food or drink quickly
ex: He gulped down the rest of his tea and went out.
他把剩下的茶一饮而尽便出去了。

zh: 咽下…（以防止感情的流露）
en: to stop yourself showing your emotions by swallowing hard
ex: She gulped back her tears and forced a smile.
她忍住泪水，强作笑容。
